task.title: Implement Codex provider through OpenClaw gateway
task.summary_zh: 實作 OpenClaw gateway 內的 Codex CLI provider，以 mounted service-user .codex 執行 non-interactive codex exec，支援 timeout redaction audit fallback。
acceptance: invokes codex exec inside gateway container using mounted CODEX_HOME
read-only workspace is default outside repair mode
repair mode requires task worktree metadata
broad bypass flags are not used
tests cover ready degraded timeout and auth failure

handoffs.message: Ready for Claude review: Codex CLI provider implemented in OpenClaw gateway adapter. Draft PR #754 https://github.com/ajoe734/pantheon/pull/754 is open; head 558c35362566a9a62fba1fc6a3d8a12c795907a4 includes implementation commit db0a50aefe329cb00edaacabe31d88bd905f8faa plus latest dev merge. GitHub checks pass: Commit trailers, Runtime mirror guard, Smoke acceptance. PR intentionally remains draft/no auto-merge until review_approved owner closeout.

Chair reassigned review from Claude to Codex2: Claude has two consecutive reviewer dispatch failures on ASST-OCGW-003 at 2026-06-01T10:59:57Z and 2026-06-01T11:05:01Z; Codex2 is the listed fallback target and is distinct from owner Codex.

Review requested changes: require X-Operator-Id on Codex provider invocation before running codex exec, and update openclaw-assistant-provider-smoke.sh to run the Codex tiny non-interactive invoke/degraded fallback required by SD 10.3. Verified: pytest -q services/openclaw-gateway-adapter/tests/test_assistant_codex_provider.py services/openclaw-gateway-adapter/test_main.py -q passed (57 tests).
